about: module tn1's mutants (wf10 TS1): edits of the TN1 engine that the conformance vectors (VectorsAreReproduced) or the law PermilleRises must notice; judged by scripts/examples -modules tn1.

mutants.name: ts1-out-scale-dropped
mutants.rule: A hidden unit adds OutScale times its out trit times its excess over its bias.

mutants.name: ts1-window-offset
mutants.rule: A hidden unit reads the lines i-1, i, i+1 and i+2.

mutants.name: ts1-conv-bias-strict
mutants.rule: A conv window fires when its sum is at least the filter's bias.

mutants.name: ts1-no-lowering
mutants.rule: The filters read the comment with A to Z lowered.

mutants.name: ts1-low-clamp
mutants.rule: A score under -8 has the probability of -8 (law PermilleRises reaches it).

mutants.name: ts1-pack-minus
mutants.rule: A packed -1 trit is the base-3 digit 2, so the model id names the weights.

mutants.name: ts2-substitution-not-closed
mutants.from:
stack = stack[:depth-1]
			let p = templateEnd(src, i+1)
mutants.rule: A } that closes a template's ${ resumes the template and closes the substitution.

mutants.name: ts2-no-regex
mutants.rule: A slash where an expression starts opens a regular expression, whose } and / are not code.

mutants.name: ts2-ternary-ends
mutants.rule: A line that starts with ? or : continues the statement before it.

mutants.name: ts2-label-not-skipped
mutants.rule: A labelled loop is a block statement: it ends at its closing brace.

mutants.name: ts2-imported-names-kept
mutants.rule: A name an import binds is not a code word wherever it is used.

mutants.name: ts2-no-handler-start
mutants.rule: A catch, or a call of catchX, starts a handler on its line.

mutants.name: ts2c-shape-tie-sets
mutants.rule: The reference vote (shapeByBit) sets a shape bit only when more runs have it than not, a tie leaving it clear; law ShapeModel holds the bit-sliced majority to it (TS-FLOOR moved the vote there; the production tie is tsf-majority-tie).

mutants.name: ts2c-code-sketch-reads-literals
mutants.from: let c = if p < to && kind[p] == 'c' { src[p] } else { byte(' ') }
mutants.to: let c = if p < to { src[p] } else { byte(' ') }
mutants.rule: Code words read only code bytes: a literal, a comment or an imported name is a space.

mutants.name: tsf-majority-tie
mutants.rule: A shape bit is set when more runs have it than not; a tie leaves it clear.

mutants.name: tsf-carry-lost
mutants.rule: Adding two bit-sliced counts carries out of a plane when two of the three bits are set.

mutants.name: tsf-module-gap-dropped
mutants.from:
for r < from && r < len(runs) {
			vote(&module, runs[r])
mutants.rule: The module's votes hold the runs between statements, not only the statements' runs.

mutants.name: tsf-punct-optional-chain
mutants.rule: ?. is one punctuator.

mutants.name: tsf-line-walk-short
mutants.rule: A token at a line's first byte is on that line.

mutants.name: tsf-lint-spans-of-code
mutants.rule: A lint finding's span is its line's comment, read from the tokens with the comments.

mutants.name: narr-stop-ignored
mutants.from: let comment = if n.stop { ContentSketchOf(l.CommentText) } else { l.CommentWords }
mutants.rule: A net that reads `words stop` sees the comment's words without StopWords.

mutants.name: narr-stop-unpacked
mutants.rule: `words stop` is part of the packed bytes, so the model's id tells the two controls apart.

mutants.name: narr-stop-list-unread
mutants.rule: ContentSketchOf leaves out the words of StopWords.

mutants.name: graph-callers-out-uncounted
mutants.rule: Project counts a declaration's uses from other packages (law ProjectIsTheModel).

mutants.name: graph-best-share-of-outside
mutants.rule: A file's best other package share is over all its uses, its own package's too (law ProjectIsTheModel).

mutants.name: graph-js-extension-unresolved
mutants.rule: A `.js` specifier names the project's `.ts` file (law ProjectIsTheModel).

mutants.name: graph-namespace-member-unread
mutants.rule: `ns.a` is a use of a, for `import * as ns` (law ProjectIsTheModel).

mutants.name: graph-depth-flat
mutants.from: let d = 1 + depthOf(q, edges, memo, state)
mutants.rule: A package's depth is its longest import chain, not one (law ProjectIsTheModel).

mutants.name: graph-renamed-import-unseen
mutants.from: let local = if renamed { code[j+2].Text } else { t.Text }
mutants.rule: `import { a as b }` binds b (law ProjectIsTheModel).

mutants.name: graph-package-fan-in-not-distinct
mutants.rule: A package's fan-in counts packages, not imports (law ProjectIsTheModel).

mutants.name: graph-default-export-unnamed
mutants.rule: A default export is the declaration an `import x from` uses (case records: graph-core-util-round.record).

mutants.name: graph-reexport-unread
mutants.rule: `export { a } from` is a use of a (case records: graph-core-index.record).

mutants.name: record-v3-node-tail-unwritten
mutants.rule: EncodeRecord writes a version 3 N item's caller fields (law RecordRoundTrips3).

mutants.name: lmd-licence-bang-dropped
mutants.rule: A /*! comment is a licence a bundler keeps: a Directive line (vector directives.ts.txt).

mutants.name: lmd-license-dropped
mutants.rule: A comment that opens with @license is a Directive line.

mutants.name: lmd-spdx-dropped
mutants.rule: An SPDX-License-Identifier: comment is a Directive line.

mutants.name: lmd-nosemgrep-dropped
mutants.rule: A nosemgrep comment is a Directive line.

mutants.name: lmd-sourcemap-dropped
mutants.rule: A //# sourceMappingURL= comment is a Directive line.

mutants.name: lmd-v8-ignore-dropped
mutants.rule: A v8 ignore comment is a Directive line.

mutants.name: lmd-c8-ignore-dropped
mutants.rule: A c8 ignore comment is a Directive line.

mutants.name: lmd-oxfmt-ignore-dropped
mutants.rule: An oxfmt-ignore comment is a Directive line.

mutants.name: lmd-directive-unanchored
mutants.rule: A directive opens the comment's body: prose that names nosemgrep or a licence later is a CommentOnly line.

mutants.name: lmd-last-line-newline-is-code
mutants.rule: The file's last line ends before its newline: a closing comment (a source map URL) is not Code.

mutants.name: nc-jsx-container-kept
mutants.rule: Removing prose inside a JSX child comment container deletes its surrounding braces too (TSXCommentsAndText).

mutants.name: nc-directive-in-jsx-deleted
mutants.rule: A JSX child comment container holding a directive keeps its surrounding braces when sibling prose is removed (TSXCommentsAndText).

mutants.name: nc-has-real-space-reads-gone
mutants.rule: Spaces inside deleted comment bytes do not count as surrounding whitespace (BlockCommentAndInlineSpacing).

mutants.name: nc-ident-glue-no-space
mutants.rule: Deleting an inline comment between identifier or number bytes inserts one space so tokens do not glue (BlockCommentAndInlineSpacing).

mutants.name: nc-block-matches-triple-slash
mutants.rule: Triple-slash directives match line comments only, never block comments (JSDocDirectivesVsProse).

mutants.name: nc-crlf-eats-cr
mutants.from: let contentEnd = if le > ls && src[le-1] == '\r' { le - 1 } else { le }
mutants.rule: Deleting a trailing comment on a CRLF line preserves the carriage return (CRLFEmptyAndCommentOnly).
